broad_families.electronic: Electronic music lineage (does not imply club function or fast tempo)
broad_families.hip_hop: Hip-hop lineage (does not assert rap vocals or instrumental role)
broad_families.pop: Pop lineage (does not imply identical mood, production or use)
broad_families.rnb_soul: R&B / soul umbrella (does not equate all R&B with soul or all substyles)

concepts.label: Ambient
concepts.note: Ambient may be electronic or acoustic; no broad family is guessed from this label alone.

concepts.label: Ambient pop
concepts.note: Pop with ambient-style associations; no electronic family inferred from the modifier alone.

concepts.label: Bass music
concepts.note: Heterogeneous electronic/club/regional umbrella; do not equate with drum-and-bass, dubstep, or a single family.

concepts.label: Chillout
concepts.note: May denote a listening use or heterogeneous sonic styles. Retain the ambiguous umbrella; do not equate with downtempo or lo-fi.

concepts.label: Conscious hip-hop
concepts.note: Thematic/context concept only; no boom-bap or other sonic style inferred.

concepts.label: Dance-pop
concepts.note: Electronic-pop neighborhood is a stylistic adjacency, not an instrumentation assertion or automatic electronic family.

concepts.label: Dance
concepts.note: Bare dance label does not distinguish function, dance-pop, or electronic dance music.

concepts.label: Downtempo
concepts.note: A style-level umbrella even when Gemini puts it in a family slot; not a BPM measurement.

concepts.label: Dream pop
concepts.note: Operational non-exhaustive pop membership. Does not instantiate a rock family or infer guitar instrumentation without further labels.

concepts.label: East Coast hip-hop
concepts.note: The explicit hip-hop name supports its broad family; geography does not imply boom-bap.

concepts.label: Indie pop
concepts.note: Musical label, not evidence of an independent record contract; not automatically dreamy or lo-fi.

concepts.label: K-Pop
concepts.note: Context only. No sonic neighborhood or broad family follows solely from the scene label.

concepts.label: Lo-fi hip-hop
concepts.note: Does not assert boom-bap, instrumental-only status, or electronic instrumentation.

concepts.label: Lo-fi
concepts.note: Production/aesthetic or genre shorthand; do not infer hip-hop from generic lo-fi.

concepts.label: R&B
concepts.note: R&B stays its own canonical concept; the broad family is a joint umbrella, not a synonym for soul.

concepts.label: R&B and Soul
concepts.note: Combined family label preserved as an umbrella; not split into two independently predicted genres.

concepts.label: Trap
concepts.note: Subtype unspecified. Do not derive a hip-hop or electronic family from this label alone.

concepts.label: Trip-hop
concepts.note: Hip-hop membership denotes lineage, not rap-led vocals or automatic compatibility with rap.

concepts.label: unknown
concepts.note: Explicit uncertainty contributes no family or neighborhood evidence.

normalization.aliases: Explicit unique lookup after lexical normalization; same-concept duplicate spellings are legal, cross-concept collisions fail.
normalization.separators: Unicode dash variants, hyphen and underscore become spaces; collapse whitespace; ampersand becomes and; preserve slash as a token. No substring, fuzzy, stemming or composite-label splitting.

policy.aggregation: Unweighted set union of explicit concept memberships; retain every primary/secondary label occurrence and evidence path. No confidence probabilities, weights, distance, compatibility scores or rejection.
policy.context_leakage: No vocal role, arrangement, texture, density, audio evidence, metadata, owner judgment or pair rating is consulted by the mapper.
policy.scene_context: Stored separately; scene/thematic labels cannot produce sonic-neighborhood memberships. An explicit genre in a context label may retain its broad family.
policy.scope: Memberships are curated, non-exhaustive operational relationships for inspection, not universal genre truth. Shared neighborhoods are not playlist ground truth; absent overlap is not incompatibility.
policy.unknown_label: Preserve verbatim with mapping_review_required and empty derived memberships. Do not guess from artist, song, owner notes, other model outputs or audio descriptions.

map.purpose: Manual inspection of the frozen free-form original 16; no numerical similarity or production use.

scene_contexts.chillout_umbrella: Ambiguous listening-context/style umbrella retained for review; no definite sonic neighborhood assigned.
scene_contexts.conscious_hip_hop_context: Thematic/cultural hip-hop label; no independent lyrical-content assessment.
scene_contexts.east_coast_hip_hop_scene: Regional hip-hop label; not an automatic boom-bap assignment or verified artist origin.
scene_contexts.korean_pop_scene: K-Pop scene/industry label, not a unique sonic style. No artist, nationality or language is independently inferred.

style_neighborhoods.alternative_pop: Explicit alternative-pop branch; not synonymous with indie, dream or electronic pop.
style_neighborhoods.ambient_related: Explicit ambient style; no inference from sparse density or hazy texture.
style_neighborhoods.atmospheric_pop: Explicit dream-pop and ambient-pop style neighborhood; not inferred from texture tags.
style_neighborhoods.bass_electronic: Named drum-and-bass/neurofunk/dubstep styles; a bare Bass Music label remains ambiguous.
style_neighborhoods.boom_bap: Explicit boom-bap style; not inferred from every hip-hop or lo-fi label.
style_neighborhoods.dance_pop: Explicit dance-pop branch; does not resolve a bare Dance label.
style_neighborhoods.disco_related: Nu-disco branch; does not automatically add pop membership.
style_neighborhoods.downtempo_related: Explicit downtempo and trip-hop style lineage; not a numeric BPM estimate.
style_neighborhoods.dub_electronic: Explicit dub-techno branch; does not infer reggae identity.
style_neighborhoods.dubstep: Explicit dubstep branch, separate from drum-and-bass.
style_neighborhoods.emo_rap: Explicit emo-rap style, not an inferred mood from audio or lyrics.
style_neighborhoods.hip_hop_beat_lineage: Boom-bap, lo-fi/chill-hop and trip-hop beat traditions; broad lineage, not a claim of the same groove or vocal role.
style_neighborhoods.house_related: Explicit microhouse branch; does not infer house from all dance labels.
style_neighborhoods.indie_pop_related: Indie-pop and dream-pop neighborhood; broad overlap, no dreamy/soft claim for all indie pop.
style_neighborhoods.instrumental_hip_hop: Explicit instrumental hip-hop label only; never inferred from a vocal-role field.
style_neighborhoods.lofi_chill_beats: Lo-fi hip-hop and chillhop neighborhood; no instrumental-only or measured-tempo claim.
style_neighborhoods.melodic_rap: Explicit melodic-rap style; does not add R&B or pop automatically.
style_neighborhoods.minimal_club: Minimal-techno / microhouse neighborhood; no measured density claim.
style_neighborhoods.modern_rnb: Contemporary and alternative R&B neighborhood; broad shared ancestry, not guaranteed compatibility.
style_neighborhoods.plugg_related: Explicit plugg style, overlapping the broader trap-related neighborhood.
style_neighborhoods.pop_electronic: Electropop, synth-pop and dance-pop adjacency; not all electronic or all pop music.
style_neighborhoods.rap_pop_crossover: Explicit pop-rap crossover, not all melodic rap.
style_neighborhoods.trap_related: Broad trap-related style lineage spanning possible crossovers; no automatic hip-hop/electronic family or identical production claim.
